Return path to profile-specific directory

projr_path_get_dir.Rd

Returns path to projr profile-specific directory. Also creates the directory if it does not exist, and ignores it if requested by _projr.yml. If the path is relative, then it is calculated with respect to the project directory, but returned relative to the current working directory.

Usage

projr_path_get_dir(
  label,
  ...,
  create = TRUE,
  format = c("auto", "relative", "absolute"),
  safe = TRUE
)

Arguments

label

character. A directory label declared under directories in the active project configuration. Each label must have a path, which may be inherited from another profile.

...

Specifies sub-directory of directory returned. Passed to file.path.

create

logical. If TRUE, then the directory is created if it does not exist and it is ignored (or not) from .gitignore and .Rbuildignore as specified in _projr.yml. Default is TRUE.

format

character. One of "auto", "relative" or "absolute". If "auto", then the format of the path returned is inherited from the format of the path specified in _projr.yml. If "relative", then the path returned is relative to the current working directory. If "absolute", then the path returned is absolute.

safe

logical. When TRUE (the default), stage outputs, documentation and package data under the configured cache for the current build version. When FALSE, return their configured final paths. Inputs and cache directories use their configured paths.

Value

Character. Path to directory requested.
